patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I jumped off the top of the slide 'cause my friend dared me. I landed on my arm and now my elbow is all fat and I can't move it. My fingers feel kind of tingly.
clinical.presentationShort: 6yo M — FOOSH from playground height; swollen tender elbow, guarded ROM, mild finger paresthesias — watch pulse & median/AIN nerve.
clinical.presentationLong: 6-year-old male, fell from playground height onto an extended arm, markedly swollen and tender elbow with guarded range of motion and mild finger paresthesias — neurovascular status must be watched closely.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → elbow X-ray, strict neurovascular checks (brachial artery / median-AIN nerve), ortho; likely reduction & pinning.
diagnosis.why: The peds fracture that can strangle the artery/nerve. Swelling + any NV change raises acuity; it's a multi-resource workup → Acute.
diagnosis.redFlag: Finger paresthesias — supracondylar fractures threaten the brachial artery and the median/anterior interosseous nerve.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting, cradling a swollen elbow, holding it very still
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 6-year-old boy in playground clothes, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting, cradling a visibly swollen elbow and holding it very still. Expression: in real pain and worried. Clearly visible: a swollen right elbow held rigidly still. No text, no logos.
